property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the Path (a FlexObject, SplineItem, Polygon, GraphicLine, Rectangle, Oval, TextFrame, EndnoteTextFrame, MediaItem, Sound, Movie, Button, MultiStateObject, ClippingPathSettings or TextWrapPreference).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the Path within its containing object.

property.name: entirePath
property.shortdesc: A list of the coordinates of all of the path points on the path, including anchor points and left- and right-direction points. When creating a path using this property, supply either a list of anchor point coordinates ([[x1, y1], [x2, y2], ...]) or a list of anchor point, left-direction point, and right-direction point coordinates ([[[x1, y1], [x2, y2], [x3, y3]], [[x4, y4], [x5, y5], [x6, y6]], ...]). Note: Providing only anchor points results in a path on which all of the path points are connected with straight line segments; supplying the positions of left- and right-direction points specifies curved line segments. Can return: Array of Arrays of 2 Units.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the Path.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
